rendered: The anode-free full cell, built with a pre-sodiated pyrite cathode, reaches an energy density of ∼400 Wh/kg[1], calculated on the mass of the presodiated pyrite and the carbon nucleation layer. The theoretical maximum for LIB technology, LiCoO2/graphite cells, is 387 Wh/kg[2]. So the full cell's energy density sits slightly above that LiCoO2/graphite ceiling. The authors add that, assuming a 50%[3] packaging penalty, the cell exceeds current LIB technology.
